    add = { value = oe_ecc_sees_good multiply = 5 }
    subtract = { value = oe_ecc_sees_lost multiply = 5 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ecc_hes var:oe_ecc_hes >= 45 } add = 10 }
    if = { limit = { has_policy = oe_byz_ecumenical_patriarch_policy } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { OR = { oe_ecc_union_made = yes has_country_modifier = oe_br_union_scandal } } add = -10 }

    max = 100
}
